description: Search TurboStarter documentation across every product. Returns ranked hits with URLs and snippets. Prefer short queries of 2-5 words for one concept; long keyword dumps often return no results.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

query.description: Short search query of 2-5 words for one concept (e.g. 'dark mode', 'billing stripe'). Do not stuff synonyms or the full question into one query.

name: search_docs
